title: Campanato input on a graph piece: L^2 oscillation of Du controlled by the tilt-excess at the graph point (step 9 of the rate proof)
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (Ω : Set (Rn n)), AEStronglyMeasurable V.tangentProj V.weight → ContinuousOn u Ω → (∀ A : Set (Rn n), MeasurableSet A → A ⊆ Ω → ∀ g : Amb n ℓ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → ∫⁻ x in A, g (q (graphPoint x (u x))) ≤ ∫⁻ y in q '' graphOver u A, g y ∂V.weight) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict Ω), V.tangentProj (q (graphPoint x (u x))) = (Submodule.map q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (fderiv ℝ u x v)))).starProjection) → ∀ (S : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)) (z : Rn n) (r s : ℝ), 0 < s → closedBall z r ⊆ Ω → (∀ x ∈ closedBall z r, hsNorm (fderiv ℝ u x) ≤ 1 / 4) → (∀ x ∈ closedBall z r, ‖q (graphPoint x (u x)) - q (graphPoint z (u z))‖ ≤ s) → (Submodule.map q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (fderiv ℝ u z v)))).starProjection = S.starProjection → V.weight (closedBall (q (graphPoint z (u z))) s) < ⊤ → ∫⁻ x in closedBall z r, ENNReal.ofReal (hsNormSq (fderiv ℝ u x - fderiv ℝ u z)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (s ^ n * V.tiltExcess (q (graphPoint z (u z))) s S)
